response.sql:
WITH per_race AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS race_name,
         AVG(cr.points) AS avg_points,
         COUNT(*) AS result_count
  FROM constructorResults AS cr
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
  WHERE cr.points > 1.0
  GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
), scored AS (
  SELECT raceId, race_name, avg_points, result_count,
         avg_points / AVG(avg_points) OVER (PARTITION BY race_name) AS ratio
  FROM per_race
)
SELECT raceId, race_name, avg_points, result_count, ratio
FROM scored
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each row in constructorResults is one result to count and include when its points exceed 1.0; race-name averages give equal weight to each qualifying race's per-race average.
